ext_trig_endtime_sign.description: Sign of the external trigger end time.
ext_trig_endtime_sign.comments: Controls whether the end time is interpreted forward or backward relative to the trigger.

ext_trig_endtime.description: Configuration of external trigger end time.

gen_idle.description: Enable comma word in LVDS data stream.

ms_debug.description: Debug setting for multi-switch / coarse-counter selection logic.

tx_mode.description: Combined transmit mode setting introduced in MuTRiG3.
tx_mode.comments: Replaces older PRBS and short-event related flags.

sync_ch_rst.comments: '1': use internally synchronized reset signal for PLL reset. '0': feed reset input directly to PLL.

disable_coarse.comments: Not connected; leave at 1. CC clock output enable in Timebase/CoarseCounter block.

pll_envomonitor.description: Enable PLL monitor output on pin pll_mon.

ms_limits.description: Coarse-counter selection range based on fine-counter value.
ms_limits.comments: Tune if side peaks at ±16 are seen.

ms_switch_sel.description: Polarity / selection behavior for coarse-counter selection range.
ms_switch_sel.comments: Tune together with ms_limits if side peaks at ±16 are seen.

dmon_sel.description: Digital monitor selection added in MuTRiG3.
dmon_sel.comments: 5-bit selection field placed in the header / global part of the stream.

dmon_sw.comments: In MuTRiG3 this is moved out of the per-channel settings and placed with the global / header settings.

vncnt.comments: If spikes are seen in the coarse counter distribution, increase this. Set to 0 to unlock PLL.

vnhitlogic.comments: Adjust if side peaks or analog-independent noise hits are seen.

vnvcodelay.description: VCO base current via charge pump.
vnvcodelay.comments: Used to tune PLL locking at wrong frequencies.

amon_en.comments: Monitor driver setting. Not connected on SMB2.

amon_dac.comments: Monitor driver setting. Not connected on SMB2.

lvds_tx_vcm.comments: Typical value around 155 = 1.1 V. Range 0..255 corresponds to 0..1.8 V.

lvds_tx_bias.comments: Default 0. Used only if higher driving strength is needed. 63 corresponds to about 4.5 mA additional current.

coin_xbar_lower_rx_ena.description: Enable coincidence passout LVDS RX on lower side.

coin_xbar_lower_tx_ena.description: Enable coincidence passout LVDS TX on lower side.

coin_xbar_lower_tx_vdac.description: LVDS common voltage DAC for lower TX coincidence passout.
coin_xbar_lower_tx_vdac.comments: 0..1.8 V, 8-bit, ascending. Nominal value 155 is about 1.1 V.

coin_xbar_lower_tx_idac.description: LVDS TX bias current for lower TX coincidence passout.
coin_xbar_lower_tx_idac.comments: Nominal value 0; nonzero only if higher driving strength is required. Maximum 63 corresponds to about 4.5 mA additional current.

coin_mat_xbl.description: Lower-side coincidence matrix boundary / neighbor configuration.
coin_mat_xbl.comments: Typical values: 0x0c for 1 neighbour, 0x1e for 2 neighbours, 0x3f for 3 neighbours.

coin_mat_xbu.description: Upper-side coincidence matrix boundary / neighbor configuration.
coin_mat_xbu.comments: Called COIN_MAT_XBH in some documentation. Typical values: 0x0c for 1 neighbour, 0x1e for 2 neighbours, 0x3f for 3 neighbours.

coin_wnd.comments: No detailed description provided in the source markdown.

coin_xbar_upper_rx_ena.description: Enable coincidence passout LVDS RX on upper side.

coin_xbar_upper_tx_ena.description: Enable coincidence passout LVDS TX on upper side.

coin_xbar_upper_tx_vdac.description: LVDS common voltage DAC for upper TX coincidence passout.
coin_xbar_upper_tx_vdac.comments: 0..1.8 V, 8-bit, ascending. Nominal value 155 is about 1.1 V.

coin_xbar_upper_tx_idac.description: LVDS TX bias current for upper TX coincidence passout.
coin_xbar_upper_tx_idac.comments: Nominal value 0; nonzero only if higher driving strength is required. Maximum 63 corresponds to about 4.5 mA additional current.

coin_mat.comments: There are 32 values per ASIC, one for each channel. In this project the values are stored under TDCs even though conceptually they are channel-wise.

mask.description: Mask a channel so it is not read out.

recv_all.description: Send the hit structure of long events, but the energy timestamp is actually the next T timestamp.

tthresh.comments: 0..63. Lower values are higher thresholds. Zero-noise region is around 32.

tthresh_offset_0.description: Bit 0 of split timing-threshold offset field.
tthresh_offset_0.comments: Derived from tthresh_offset. Repurposed from inputbias_sc in MuTRiG2.

tthresh_offset_1.description: Bit 1 of split timing-threshold offset field.
tthresh_offset_1.comments: Derived from tthresh_offset. Repurposed from sipm_sc in MuTRiG2.

tthresh_offset_2.description: Bit 2 of split timing-threshold offset field.
tthresh_offset_2.comments: Derived from tthresh_offset. Introduced by reusing one bit from the old 3-bit MuTRiG2 tthresh_sc.

ethresh.comments: 0 corresponds to 1.8 V, 255 to 0 V. For SiPM signals usually around 90..150.

ebias.comments: Use 0..3 for small signals / better linearity, 4..7 for larger signals and shorter ToT.

sipm.description: Voltage tuning at SiPM input terminal.
sipm.comments: 0 = low voltage, 63 = high voltage. Keep near the middle, around 15 to low 20s.

inputbias.description: Main bias current of the input stage.
inputbias.comments: Higher values mean higher current. Changes bandwidth, input impedance, terminal voltage, timing and energy resolution.

pole.description: DAC setting for pole-zero cancellation feature.

pole_sc.description: Scale / auxiliary control for pole setting.

ampcom.description: Amplifier bias-current tuning to change gain and comparator hysteresis.
ampcom.comments: For now often set value to 0 and scale to 2 to effectively turn off.

ampcom_sc.comments: Changes how AMPCOM affects gain and hysteresis.

cml.comments: Usually keep near middle values, around 8, with scale 0. For TDC injection set to 0.

amonctrl.comments: 0 none; 1 top_monitor; 2 input stage cascode; 3 timing trigger P; 4 SiPM_vbias / cascode bias; 5 timing trigger N; 6 fb_pbias; 7 energy trigger N.

tdctest_n.description: Disable TDC test input to this channel.
tdctest_n.comments: 0 enables TDC test input and shorts it with the normal hitlogic output.

pole_en_n.description: Enable DAC for pole-zero cancellation when 0.
pole_en_n.comments: Only controls the DAC, not the feature itself.

energy_c_en.description: Enable capacitor in the low-pass filter before the E-comparator.

energy_r_en.description: Enable resistor in the low-pass filter before the E-comparator.

cm_sensing_high_r.description: Enable high-impedance source in the feedback path.

amon_en_n.description: Disable analog monitor output from this channel when 1.
amon_en_n.comments: Only up to one channel per chip should enable analog monitor output.

edge_cml.description: Invert polarity of digital signals to hitlogic in the channel.

dmon_en.description: Enable digital monitor for this channel.
dmon_en.comments: MuTRiG2 field; removed in MuTRiG3 and moved out of channel settings.

dmon_sw_channel_legacy.description: Digital monitor output mode for a channel.
dmon_sw_channel_legacy.comments: MuTRiG2 field; removed from channel settings in MuTRiG3 and moved to global/header logic.

dummy_config.description: Ignore different replies from ASICs when configuring via SPI.

dummy_data_fast.description: Produce short events in FPGA dummy data generator.

dummy_data_n.description: Number of hits generated per ASIC by the FPGA dummy data generator.
